statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold while expiry-day rates and flow stress stay elevated.
recommendation: Current evidence shows broad pressure and 5% Treasury yields, but not a confirmed persistent no-retracement NQ path; the expiration close remains the key conditional checkpoint.
headline: WATCH Tail as 5% yields meet expiration-day selling
body: U.S. equities are broadly lower as the 10-year Treasury yield reaches about 5%. Fresh supplementary breadth is mixed across megacaps and semiconductors, so current evidence supports extreme Stress without a confirmed pathological one-way NQ path.
